# docs/: mirror of the claude.ai Project "Living mythos"

Snapshot of the Project's docs and research files, copied 2026-10-30 so they can be read from the repo, the laptop or a cloud session.

**The Project is the source of truth.** Planning happens in the Project. If a file here disagrees with the Project copy, the Project wins, and this mirror needs a refresh. Do not edit these files to change a decision: change the Project's `design/decision-log.md` first, then re-sync.

## Layout (same paths as the Project)
| Folder | Holds |
|---|---|
| `design/` | `decision-log.md`: settled decisions and the 7 determinism hard rules |
| `research/` | Gemini prompts, research reports and their reviews; the six Gemini report PDFs |
| `claude/` | Project index, handoff, Project instructions. These are written for claude.ai planning chats; Claude Code should take its working rules from the root `CLAUDE.md`, not from the handoff's "instructions for Claude" section |
| `archive/` | Closed or fully absorbed docs, kept for evidence and unscheduled ideas |

## Notes on the copy
- The PDF `Open Source Repositories for Civilization Simulation.pdf` was uploaded to the Project with a truncated name ("...Simulati...."). The full word "Simulation" is a guess.
- `research/novelty-report-gemini.txt` is a raw text extraction of a PDF. Its page-break characters were turned into line breaks when copied here.
